subject: MAP: final security checkpoints & close runway — Evergreen Bank
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@evergreenbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@evergreenbank.com
Date: 2027-04-01 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security checkpoints

Hannah — thanks for the MAP template. A few items our security team will need clarified before we can sign off on the evaluation window and procurement timeline:

- SOC 2 report currency: we need confirmation the report will be made available and cover the last 12 months (or an attestation for the gap).
- SIG/CAIQ: can you provide an editable spreadsheet or the completed assessment? We prefer to review a completed SIG and then ask targeted follow-ups.
- DPA redlines: procurement will produce a first-pass redline; can Redwood accept a 30-day negotiation cadence?
- Data retention: our legal requires a config option for retention windows per environment (prod vs staging) and an EU-residency option for PII.

We'd like to lock the MAP milestones this week so the vendor evaluation (PoC) can start 4/18. Can your team confirm availability for an evidence intake call on 4/6?

—Tom
Director, Platform Security
Evergreen Bank

[attachment: procurement_terms.pdf]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security checkpoints

Tom — appreciate the clear list. Quick responses and plan below; I've attached a MAP workbook with milestone owners and timelines.

Answers (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood can provide the latest SOC 2 Type II (period ending 2027-01-31) during evidence intake. If you need an attestation for the months after, we can provide a management assertion and a plan for a scoped SOC bridge.
- SIG/CAIQ: attaching a completed SIG v2026 spreadsheet (redacted for internal demo). We'll bring the full CAIQ to the intake call and walk through any control specifics you flag.
- DPA: 30-day negotiation cadence is acceptable; legal prefers to prioritize data residency and subprocessors early in redlines so they don't block the rest of the MAP.
- Data retention & residency: Redwood supports per-environment retention policies and has an EU region deployment option. We'll capture the exact retention windows in the MAP.

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) Evidence intake call — 2027-04-06 (security + engineering) — action: SIG pass + SOC doc handoff
2) PoC start (dedicated cluster) — 2027-04-18 — action: test workload + latency/cost benchmarks
3) Legal redline round 1 (DPA) — 2027-04-25 — action: primary redlines resolved or escrow plan defined
4) Final acceptance & signoff — target 2027-05-06

Jordan/Kim — can you confirm who's owning the PoC infra and the evidence handoff? Tom — I'll send calendar invites for the intake call once we confirm attendees.

Best,
Hannah
Sr. GTM Security Manager
Redwood Inference

[attachment: MAP_Evergreen_2027-04-01.xlsx]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security checkpoints

Hannah — I'll own PoC infra. Quick notes from infra planning: 

- We can provision a dedicated evaluation pool (2 x A100 equivalent, isolated VPC) for the PoC starting 4/18; will need Evergreen's IP allowlist for support tunnels by 4/13.
- We'll prepare a small dataset subset with synthetic PII for performance tests; retention for that dataset can be set to 7 days by default.
- For EU residency ask: we can spin a staging region in eu-west-1; latency/throughput will differ — I'll add a brief note in the MAP workbook.

Kim — can you lead the SIG review on the intake call? Jordan will share the infra checklist and access steps.

-Jordan
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[attachment: SIG_Assessment_v1.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@evergreenbank.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + security checkpoints

Tom — great to meet you on the call yesterday. A few follow-ups and concrete asks to keep the MAP on schedule:

1) Evidence intake deliverables (please upload to the secured intake link before 04/06 09:00 PT):
   - Latest SOC 2 report (PDF)
   - Completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet or point-of-contact for follow-ups
   - Any IP allowlist ranges for support and tunnel access

2) DPA redlines: procurement, please share your initial redline by 04/08 so legal can triage items into "must-resolve" vs "deferred" buckets. Our legal will respond to top-priority clauses within 5 business days.

3) Retention matrix: Tom, please confirm retention windows for the three classes below so we can lock config flags in the PoC environment:
   - Session logs / debug traces (suggested: 7 days)
   - Customer prompts & models (suggested: 90 days default, configurable)
   - Exported artifacts / reports (suggested: 365 days)

Next steps: Hannah will push the MAP workbook update today with owners and dates; Jordan will share the infra playbook and the EU-region note; I'll coordinate legal's availability for the 04/25 redline review.

Thanks — Kim
Director, Enterprise Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
